Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting victim files and renaming them with pattern [filename].id-[id].[email_address].xtbl
Impacted Systems: Files encrypted by CrySiS ransomware (Word, Excel, PDF, music, image files)
Indicators of Compromise: Other email variants: Vegclass@aol.com.xtbl, gerkaman@aol.com.xtb, johnycryptor@hackermail.com.xtbl, Milarepa.lotos@aol.com.xtbl
Method of Attack: File encryption with ransom note via email address in filename
Discoverer: Kaspersky Labs (used released keys to update RakhniDecryptor)
Method of Attack: Decryption tool updated to decrypt CrySiS encrypted files using released master keys
Attack Vector: Decryption tool used by victims to recover files
